text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bosnian refugee vote turnout in 55 countries is 75 per cent, OSCE's spokeswoman Agota Cooperman says.
- Pensions for April to be paid out in next few days, Bosnian Finance Minister Mirsad Kikanovic says.
- Bosnian parliament endorses President Alija Izetbegovic's report on collective presidency's work in last five years. --Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
